note: WIDE funnel for the single 'science' category, restricted to its allowed_domains. Science window = 14 days / 336h (start ~2026-07-17T22:00Z); every item date-verified via og article:published_time / JSON-LD / byline and gated FRESH via `python3 pipeline/freshness.py <iso> 2026-07-31T22:00:41Z science`. Per the rotation plan I emphasized fresher axes (astronomy/ML cosmology, quantum ML+chemistry, materials, climate/geoscience ML, research-automation) and de-emphasized the just-saturated protein/enzyme, genomics, QEC, BCI and battery beats. Outlet diversity is moderate: phys.org (3, at the =3 collection cap), techxplore.com (2), thequantuminsider.com (1), technologyreview.com (1) = 4 distinct outlets; ax-curator later tightens to <=2/outlet. WHY not wider: newscientist.com is blocked to our agent; physics.aps.org 'Quantum Neural Networks Face the Hardware Test' (v19/100, ~Jul 22) returned HTTP 403 (unverifiable -> dropped); space.com 'AI finds 27,000 asteroids' and universetoday 'ML classified half a million galaxies' had no extractable published date (dropped, never guessed). items.title: Seven possible quasar lenses emerge from AI scan of 800,000 DESI objects
items.excerpt: Researchers trained an AI model on simulated quasar-galaxy spectra and applied it to ~800,000 DESI quasars, surfacing seven strong gravitational-lens candidates and roughly doubling the known sample. A concrete case of ML mining sky-survey data to find rare objects for studying early black holes and galaxy evolution.

items.title: AI and quantum chemistry combine to identify efficient blue OLED materials
items.excerpt: Nagoya University researchers paired quantum-chemistry simulation with machine learning to design boron-free molecules that emit vivid, high-color-purity blue light for next-gen OLED displays. Shows ML compressing the search for new functional materials with a real display-tech payoff.

items.title: Soil carbon effectively measured by new, efficient AI model
items.excerpt: Cornell researchers built BINN, a biogeochemistry-informed neural network that measures soil organic carbon about 50x faster than prior methods while keeping accuracy. One of the first AI tools advancing discovery in agriculture and biogeochemistry, with implications for climate modeling.

items.title: AI-powered system offers unprecedented insight into the forces shaping Earth's climate
items.excerpt: Tel Aviv University's GOFLOW is an AI system that reconstructs hidden ocean-surface currents directly from satellite imagery, extracting dynamics previously inaccessible. A new ML method that turns existing observations into better climate prediction inputs.

items.title: AI extracts hidden material rules from microscopic data to predict large-scale behavior
items.excerpt: NUS researchers created ML methods that learn large-scale material behavior from microscopic data by discovering hidden variables that capture collective dynamics, cutting computational cost. A methods advance for predicting how materials evolve, relevant to energy and manufacturing.

items.title: Cleveland Clinic and IBM researchers create quantum machine learning framework to predict neoantigen immune response
items.excerpt: Cleveland Clinic and IBM built Q-CHIPP, a quantum machine-learning framework that outperformed classical methods at predicting cancer neoantigens likely to trigger an immune response, learning from datasets as small as 150 samples on 46-qubit hardware. A concrete quantum-ML method for a data-scarce scientific problem.

items.title: How AI helps scientists design the next generation of medicines
items.excerpt: A look at how machine-learning models now enhance every stage of pharmaceutical R&D -- design, make, test, analyze -- compressing timelines and cracking previously intractable discovery problems. Maps how AI is reshaping the day-to-day method and craft of drug research.
